Election Commission to Hold Special Voter Enrollment Camps

The Election Commission of India (ECI) has announced special voter enrollment camps to be held in colleges on September 29-30. Additionally, special camps were scheduled for September 27 to enroll eligible electors who may have been left out. The ECI has received 1.21 lakh applications for Form-6, which is used for new voter registration.
